gist.headline: The garden noticeboard rotates
gist.blurb: The README’s little daily newspaper has fresh Latest News and a newly plotted star-history trail. Even open-source gardens need someone to update the signpost.
gist.summary: Refreshed the README’s Latest News section and star-history SVG charts for 2026-08-22, while keeping Recent Apps synchronized when new apps are published.
gist.impact: Visitors to the repository get an up-to-date snapshot of project news, community apps, and GitHub star growth.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy open-source garden noticeboard represents the refreshed README: Polli, wearing a tiny librarian scarf, pins a fresh news sheet beside a gently rising star chart. Small code-flowers and app-icon seedlings surround the board, with a friendly CRT monitor robot helping hold the chart.
